entry.title: Urban Dictionary: :#

entry.title: Urban Dictionary: *~*
entry.summary: Symbol or emo-con for eating pussy or oral sex. Consists of a smiley face with an tilde symbol for the tongue. Used for flirting, sexual activity, etc.
